text.content: CWAM-DLC-ROB365-B5-VOM-R8-I20000-8GPU-S42-R1-20260819 - fixed B5 visual object memory formal evaluation

Evaluate whether the fixed CWAM Cosmos3 B5 VOM R8 iteration-20000 EMA policy, with online recurrent visual-object memory active, completes the matched formal RoboCasa365 atomic protocol on one eight-GPU DLC worker.

The exact 6-file, 30,765,172,964-byte checkpoint inventory and 1086-key EMA contract must pass; both four-rank policy servers and both one-episode CUDA/EGL gates must pass; formal completion requires exactly 340 valid terminal rows across 17 tasks and a COMPLETE record in the unique OSS run root.
Training source 88f3c95c18a3f3195b66e35b2cd8f6ecfe595b81; evaluation control commit will be fixed before DLC submission.

Fixed B5 VOM R8 iter_000020000 EMA BF16 DCP; online visual history length 3; eight visual memory tokens; object-memory delta main path and aligned-vs-zero/shuffle policy ranking active; RoboCasa365 atomic 17 tasks x 20 episodes; seed=42; max_steps=400; horizon=12; UniPC=30; guidance=1.0; two parallel four-rank FSDP policy servers.
RoboCasa 29f7ce8814c1547f5af762a0997fbd4b64848dd7; robosuite 232ce7d4a6ed89c949a9aba024a05c8c32fdd08b; DeMiAn evaluator 2600ece5bf0eeacf010a95f084dcda2de6d30d59; RoboCasa365 atomic split.

Alibaba PAI DLC PyTorch 2.7.1 CUDA 12.8 image; CPFS fixed source/control and OSS checkpoint/output mounts; B5 source revision 88f3c95c18a3f3195b66e35b2cd8f6ecfe595b81; worker-local model, environment, assets, and active evaluator output with terminal OSS publication.
Exactly-once generic DLC submission after checkpoint transfer and immutable-control audit; priority 7; one worker; eight RTX 4090 GPUs.
Alibaba PAI DLC; 1 worker; 8 x RTX 4090 48 GB; 126 CPU; 960 GiB RAM/shared memory.
CWAM-DLC-ROB365-COSMOS3-B5-VOM-R8-I20000-EMA-340EP-S42-R1-20260819

Pending: exact OSS checkpoint audit, two-server model-load gate, two one-episode graphics gates, first formal result, overall success/340, per-task success rates, valid row count, and terminal publication.
Comparison boundary

This is a checkpoint-fixed evaluation. The policy weights are not retrained or adapted on DLC. The evaluator protocol, task split, seed, rollout horizon, sampler, and eight-GPU server topology are matched to the B4, B2, and B3 formal evaluations.
Online memory boundary

B5 receives current observations plus a causal deque of prior visual observations with maximum length three. The history is cleared on every episode reset. The trained visual-memory conditioner and object-local memory-delta action path are active; no future frame, future action, success label, or privileged simulator state is provided.
Checkpoint boundary

Evaluation target is B5-VOM-R8-I20000-EMA-BF16-OVERLAY-v1, published from the fixed B4 serving base plus the B5 iter_000020000 strong-action delta from CWAM-COSMOS3-B5-VOM-FORMAL-R8-HIGH-UTIL-B128-20K-20260817. The serving DCP contains 6 files totaling 30,765,172,964 bytes, including 30,765,145,838 bytes under model/, one semantically complete shard, and 1086 EMA parameter keys. Exact 1086/1086 BF16 tensor readback passed after OSS publication.
Scheduling boundary

The 72-hour estimate is worker runtime. Current ETA additionally allows queueing behind existing eight-GPU evaluations on the same DLC quota. Submission, Queuing, Running, real episode progress, and terminal completion are reported separately.
